attr.title: ReNFS5: Recomp Unleashed
attr.desc: Experimental ARM64 static-recompilation port of Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (2000, v3.2) for H700 handhelds. DirectDraw7/Direct3D7 is translated to OpenGL ES 3, resolved through SDL2 (no direct Mali dependency). Players supply their own game files (folder, ZIP or CD image); the native launcher unpacks and verifies them, with no Python or unzip needed on device. Settings UI: frame cap, FPS counter, resolution, aspect, movies, controller mapping. On H700 races mostly run above 30 FPS.
attr.inst: Extract nfs5.zip into the device's ports folder (not the SD-card root). Put your own game files into nfs5/source/: the installed game folder, a .zip of it, or a CD image (.iso, .bin + .cue, or .mdf + .mds). The native launcher unpacks the image/zip with built-in code, verifies what it finds, copies the game into nfs5/data/ (allow ~1.5 GiB free) and opens the settings menu. Player data is kept beside the binaries in nfs5/saves/ and nfs5/configs/. Then launch NFS5. Requires AArch64 firmware with glibc 2.36+, SDL2, SDL2_ttf and an OpenGL ES 3.x driver that SDL2 can load.
